mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_memory (memory_id, messages) VALUES (#{memoryId}, #{messages}) ON CONFLICT (memory_id) DO UPDATE SET messages = EXCLUDED.messages

INSERT INTO chat_memory (memory_id, messages, summary) VALUES (#{memoryId}, COALESCE(#{messages}, (SELECT messages FROM chat_memory WHERE memory_id = #{memoryId})), #{summary}) ON CONFLICT (memory_id) DO UPDATE SET messages = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.messages, chat_memory.messages), summary = EXCLUDED.summary
